name: Black start diesel generator
description: Black start diesel generator for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Procurement / Electrical. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts. Primary source: https://cummins.com/sites/default/files/2025-08/diesel-gen-set-rating-cards-international-50hz-2025-aug.pdf

specifications.metric: Cummins commercial diesel generator se — Standby rating, smallest listed model C17D5
specifications.unit: kVA standby (13 kWe); prime 15 kVA / 12 kWe; X2.5-G2 engine
specifications.basis: Cummins Bulletin 6614069 Rev. 8/25 (August 2025), International 50 Hz range rating card; PDF blocked by WebFetch, read via r.jina.ai 2026-11-25

specifications.metric: Cummins commercial diesel generator se — Standby rating, model C3000D5

specifications.metric: Black-start diesel generating package  — Starting logic
specifications.basis: Electrical Engineering Portal, 'Design engineering and the black start of a power plant', published 2024-08-19, section 2 Black start; WebFetch read of HTML 2026-11-25 (value: diesel engine starts on a sustained three-second loss of voltage and is self-ene)

specifications.metric: Black-start diesel generating package  — Sizing rule for the largest motor
specifications.unit: times the rating of the largest pump motor (standby diesel MW capacity)
specifications.basis: Electrical Engineering Portal article 2024-08-19, section 2: 'the standby diesel engine has a MW capacity that is at least 1.5 times the rating of the largest pump motor'; read 2026-11-25

specifications.metric: Black-start diesel generating package  — UPS and station battery autonomy
specifications.basis: Electrical Engineering Portal article 2024-08-19, section 2: UPS and station battery need enough capacity to operate the control system for four to eight hours; read 2026-11-25

specifications.metric: Black-start diesel generating package  — Illustrative auxiliary load for a 100 MW hydro unit
specifications.unit: kW of operating auxiliary load to initiate power production; one 1 MW diesel gen
specifications.basis: Electrical Engineering Portal article 2024-08-19, section 2; illustrative example, not a rating for this project; read 2026-11-25

specifications.metric: Black-start diesel generating package  — Diesel generator efficiency at full / half load
specifications.unit: % at full load / about 37% at half load, before auxiliary plant load
specifications.basis: Electrical Engineering Portal article 2024-08-19, section 1.3 Fuel storage requirements; read 2026-11-25

specifications.metric: Black-start diesel generating package  — Black Start definition under Sabah Distribution Code
specifications.basis: Sabah Distribution Code glossary, 'Black Start'; PDF posted 2024-01-05; read via r.jina.ai 2026-11-25 (value: the procedure necessary for a recovery from a Total Blackout or Partial Blackout)

specifications.metric: Black-start diesel generating package  — Distributed Generating Unit definition
specifications.basis: Sabah Distribution Code glossary; read via r.jina.ai 2026-11-25 (value: a Generating Unit connected to the Distribution System identified as being capab)
